claims.quote: Betta uberis is a small bubble-nesting labyrinth fish from peat swamp forests in Central and West Kalimantan, Borneo, Indonesia.

regions.name: Arut
regions.quote: The majority of records pertain to an area sandwiched between the lower Arut and Kumai rivers, south of the towns of Pangkalan Bun and Kumai in Kalimantan Tengah (Central Kalimantan) province, Borneo, Indonesia.

regions.name: Sampit
regions.quote: Additional collections have taken place in the Sampit river basin to the east, and several hundred kilometres further north in Sukadana district, Kalimantan Barat (West Kalimantan) province.
